title: Divisorial presentations and reduced component unions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $M$ an etale log structure as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and $U\subseteq X$ open. The predicate that $M$ is the divisorial structure for $U$ means an isomorphism of its monoid presheaf with $W\mapsto\{s\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W):s|_{W\times_X U}\text{ is a unit}\}$ commuting with the structural maps into functions. For ideal sheaves $D,B$ on $X$, in particular a normal crossings divisor $B$ as in [def-trf-normal-crossings-divisor], $D$ is a reduced union of irreducible components of $B$ when $D=\sqrt D$ and for some set $S$ of irreducible components of the closed subscheme defined by $B$, $|D|=\bigcup_{C\in S}\operatorname{image}(C\to X)$. The empty selection gives the empty divisor; no regularity of global components or absence of self-intersections is imposed.
